description: This file provides string formatting utility functions for converting strings to camelCase and Title Case, used across a frontend application to ensure consistent string rendering.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase; handles spaces, underscores, hyphens, and multiple whitespace. Returns original value if not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case, capitalizing the first letter of each word and after apostrophes, preserving accented characters and apostrophes.
